blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Indian court proceedings are held in English, so speakers of languages with limited translation technology have limited access to them. We present the first English Mizo parallel dataset of Indian court judgments. It contains 13,168 sentence pairs from the Gauhati High Court and the Supreme Court of India. Professional native Mizo translators translated complete documents; sentence pairs were manually aligned, and two independent reviewers checked the results. Our study finds that English words are borrowed in a very selective way: official and legal terms are almost always kept in English, but words for everyday things like actions, situations, and results are usually expressed in native Mizo. Mizo diacritics are also used inconsistently across the corpus. When we fine tune the NLLB 200 1.3B model on our training data, it scores 27.47 BLEU on a balanced legal test set of 1,000 sentence pairs, an improvement of 7.16 BLEU over the base model. However, it still uses English words about three times more often than a human translator does.
blocks.zh: 印度的法庭诉讼程序以英语进行,因此,讲翻译技术有限的语言的人获得这些语言的机会有限。 我们提供了第一套关于印度法院判决的英文Mizo并行数据集。 其中收录了高哈蒂高等法院和印度最高法院的13,168对判决. 专业本地Mizo翻译翻译了完整的文件;句子对齐是手动对齐的,两名独立审查员检查了结果. 我们的研究发现,英语单词的借取方式是非常有选择性的:官方和法律术语几乎总是用英语来保留,但日常事物的用词如行动,情况,结果通常用原生的米佐来表达. 水上二甲酸盐在使用过程中也不一致。 当我们在训练数据上微调NLLB 200 1.3B模型时,它通过1000个句子的均衡法律测试集得分27.47 BLEU,比基模型改进了7.16 BLEU. 然而,它仍然使用英语单词的频率大约是人类翻译的三倍.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Access to justice depends on understanding the language of the courtroom. In India, Article 348 of the Constitution requires that proceedings in the Supreme Court and the High Courts be conducted in English, so the official text of judgments is in English even when the parties cannot read it. The Supreme Court and the e-Courts project have launched translation initiatives, but these target the languages listed in the Eighth Schedule [ 1 , 2 ] . Languages outside the Schedule receive little institutional support, and their communities are left to rely on informal, unverified oral summaries of the decisions that affect them.
blocks.zh: 诉诸司法取决于对法庭语言的理解。 在印度,宪法第348条要求最高法院和高等法院的诉讼程序以英语进行,因此即使当事人无法阅读,判决的官方文本也使用英语. 最高法院和电子法院项目启动了翻译举措,但这些举措针对第八表所列语文。 《时间表》以外的语言很少得到机构支助,他们的社区只能依靠非正式的、未经核实的口头摘要来作出影响他们的决定。

blocks.en: Mizo (also called Lushai) is one such language. It is a Tibeto-Burman language spoken by about 830 , 000 830,000 people (2011 Census of India [ 3 ] ) and is an official language of Mizoram alongside English. Because it is not in the Eighth Schedule, it is usually excluded from the major Indic datasets and models [ 4 , 5 ] . This gap is especially serious in the legal domain. Mizoram is under the Gauhati High Court, where the rulings are written only in English. As a result, Mizo speakers have almost no tools to help them read and understand court decisions themselves.
blocks.zh: 米佐语(又称卢海语)是一类语言. 它是一种西藏-布尔曼语,约有830,000,83万人使用(2011年印度人口普查[3]),是米佐拉姆语与英语并列的官方语言. 由于不在第八表,它通常被排除在主要的索引数据集和模型[4,5]之外. 这一差距在法律领域特别严重。 米佐拉姆隶属于高哈蒂高等法院,裁决只用英语书写. 因此,米佐演讲者几乎没有任何工具帮助他们自己阅读和理解法院裁决.

blocks.en: The main challenge is the domain, not just the volume of data. Most existing Mizo parallel texts are from religious writings or informal web content, which are very different from legal writing in length, sentence structure, citation style, and vocabulary. Models developed on such data transfer poorly to legal text, and until now there has been no legal test set to measure how large that gap is. As a result, progress has been less constrained by modeling capacity than by the lack of a reliable evaluation resource.
blocks.zh: 主要挑战在于域,而不仅仅是数据量. 现存的米佐平行文本大多来自宗教著作或非正式的网络内容,在长度,句子结构,引用风格,词汇等方面与法律写作有很大不同. 在这类数据上开发的模型向法律文本的转移很差,到目前为止还没有一套法律检验标准来衡量这一差距有多大。 因此,与缺乏可靠的评价资源相比,建模能力对进展的限制较小。

blocks.en: We address this with the first parallel corpus of Indian legal judgments for Mizo: 13 , 168 13,168 sentence pairs, 286 , 590 286,590 English and 291 , 751 291,751 Mizo tokens, drawn from civil, criminal and miscellaneous cases of the Gauhati High Court and the Supreme Court of India. Professional native Mizo translators with degrees in law, English, or Mizo translated entire documents, so that references and terminology remain consistent within a judgment. We then aligned the texts at the sentence level using embedding-based candidate generation followed by manual correction, and validated the result with two independent annotators (Cohen’s κ = 0.90 \kappa=0.90 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用印度对米佐的第一个平行法律判决书来解决这一问题:13,168,13,168对判决,286,590,286,590英语和291,751,291,751 米佐令牌,摘自高哈蒂高等法院和印度最高法院的民事、刑事和杂项案件。 具有法学,英语或Mizo学位的专业本土Mizo翻译翻译翻译了整个文件,因此引用和术语在判决中保持一致. 然后,我们用嵌入式候选人生成法,然后用手动校正法,在句子一级对文本进行校正,然后用两个独立的注释器(Cohen's ob = 0.90\kappa = 0.90)验证结果。

blocks.en: Beyond releasing the data, we analyze its linguistic properties. Because Mizo has no indigenous common-law vocabulary, translating Indian legal English into Mizo involves systematic borrowing: 6 , 612 6,612 word types occur on both sides of the corpus, and 55.30 % 55.30\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of Mizo tokens are strings that also appear in the English vocabulary. The borrowing is selective. Names of institutions and statutory instruments— court , FIR , IPC , and affidavit —are kept in English almost all the time (close to 100 % 100\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ). In contrast, words referring to people, legal processes, and outcomes— accused ( 8.5 % 8.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) and conviction ( 5.0 % 5.0\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} )—are usually replaced with native Mizo words. We link this pattern to referential rigidity : the English form is kept exactly in those cases where replacing it could create ambiguity. We also observe substantial orthographic variation on the Mizo side. Circumflex tone marking appears only in 2.70 % 2.70\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of Mizo segments, 159 159 types are attested both with and without it, and the t / ṭ contrast is largely unrealized–variation that affects tokenization and comparability between systems.
blocks.zh: 除了发布数据之外,我们分析其语言特性。 因为米佐没有本土的普通法词汇,将印度法律英语翻译为米佐涉及系统性的借词:6,612,612字类型发生在本体的两侧,55.30%的55.30\text~,}\米佐令牌的}\mathrm{\%}是英语词汇中也出现的字符串. 借款是选择性的。 各机构的名称和法定文书——法院、FIR、IPC和宣誓书——几乎总是用英文保存(接近100%的100\text{\, }\ mathrm{\%})。 反之,提到人,法律程序和结果的词语——被告(8.5% 8.5\text{\, }\mathrm{\%})和定罪(5.0% 5.0\text{\, }\mathrm{\%})——通常被原生的米佐词所取代. 我们把这种模式与优惠僵硬性联系起来:英文形式完全保留在可以造成含糊不清的情况下。 我们还观察到米佐一侧有巨大的直径变化。 Circumflex语调标记只出现在水佐部分的2.70%2.70\text{\, }\ mathrm{\%},159个类型被证明有和没有, t/ṭ的对比基本上没有实现 - - 变化会影响标语化和系统之间的可比性.

blocks.en: Finally, we create baseline systems by fine-tuning the NLLB-200 1.3 1.3 B model [ 6 ] —one of the rare open-source, large-scale translation models with explicit Mizo—using the 11 , 522 11,522 -pair training set. On a stratified 1 , 000 1,000 -pair held-out legal test , the model scores 27.47 27.47 BLEU, 50.39 50.39 chrF++, and 65.68 65.68 TER. Compared to the original, non-adapted model, this is an improvement of + 7.16 +$7.16$ BLEU, + 7.83 +$7.83$ chrF++, and a reduction of − 12.13 -$12.13$ TER. The error analysis shows that most of the remaining mistakes happen when the system has to decide whether to borrow English words. For legal terms, it keeps the English word in 21.7 % 21.7\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of the cases where the human translation uses a native Mizo word, but only 8.3 % 8.3\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} the other way around. In other words, it borrows English terms about three times more often than the human translator.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们通过微调NLLB-200 1.3 B型号[6]来创建基线系统——一种罕见的开源大型翻译模式,带有明确的 Mizo - 使用11,522 11,522 - pair训练集. 在分级的1 000 000-pair hold-out legal测试中,该型号得分为27.4727.47 BLEU、50.39 50.39 chrF++和65.68 65.68 TER。 与原型型号相比,此型号的改进为+7.16+7.16元BLEU,+7.83+7.83元chrF++,减少−12.13-12.13元TER. 错误分析显示,剩下的大部分错误发生在系统必须决定是否借用英语单词时. 在法律方面,它保留了21.7%的21.7\text{\,}\mathrm{\%}的英文单词,即人类翻译使用当地米佐词的案例,但只有8.3%的8.3\text{\,}\mathrm{\%}反之. 换句话说,它借用英语术语的频率大约是人类翻译的三倍.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We release the first English–Mizo parallel corpus in the legal domain: 13 , 168 13,168 professionally translated, manually aligned, and independently validated sentence pairs from Indian court judgments. • We analyze the corpus quantitatively, including a retention-rate study of legal terminology that shows a systematic borrowing pattern, and an audit of Mizo orthography that identifies diacritic normalization as an open preprocessing question for Mizo NLP. • We present both fine-tuned models and baseline systems on a stratified held-out legal test set, including an error analysis by stratum, thereby providing reference points for future research on Mizo legal translation.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下。 我们发布了第一个法律领域的英文-Mizo平行程序:13,168,13,168,专业翻译,手动对齐,以及印度法院判决中独立验证的对句。 我们从数量上分析本体,包括对法律术语的留置率研究,该研究显示有系统借贷模式,以及对水佐正字法的审计,该审计将二极论正常化确定为水佐 NLP的开放式预处理问题。 我们以一套分级的法律测试,包括由层层进行错误分析,提出经过微调的模型和基线系统,从而为今后米佐法律翻译研究提供参考点。

blocks.en: We release the first English–Mizo parallel corpus in the legal domain: 13 , 168 13,168 professionally translated, manually aligned, and independently validated sentence pairs from Indian court judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们发布了第一个法律领域的英语-Mizo平行程序:13,168,13,168 专业翻译,手动对齐,以及印度法院判决中独立验证的对句。

blocks.en: We analyze the corpus quantitatively, including a retention-rate study of legal terminology that shows a systematic borrowing pattern, and an audit of Mizo orthography that identifies diacritic normalization as an open preprocessing question for Mizo NLP.
blocks.zh: 我们从数量上分析本体,包括对法律术语进行保留率研究,以显示一种系统的借贷模式,以及对米佐正字法的审计,将二极论正常化确定为米佐 NLP的公开预处理问题。

blocks.en: We present both fine-tuned models and baseline systems on a stratified held-out legal test set, including an error analysis by stratum, thereby providing reference points for future research on Mizo legal translation.
blocks.zh: 我们以一套分级的法律测试,包括由层层进行错误分析,提出经过微调的模型和基线系统,从而为今后米佐法律翻译研究提供参考点。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 The Mizo language
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 米佐语

blocks.en: Mizo is spoken mainly in Mizoram, with communities in neighboring northeast Indian states, Myanmar’s Chin State, and Bangladesh’s Chittagong Hill Tracts [ 7 , 8 ] . The standard written variety is based on the Duhlian dialect.
blocks.zh: Mizo主要在Mizoram, 标准书写品种采用杜鹃花方言.

blocks.en: Three properties matter for our corpus. First, Mizo is agglutinative, with extensive particles and derivational affixation, so a root appears on many surfaces; this is shown in the vocabulary and hapax counts in Section 4 . Second, Mizo is tonal, but this tone is only partly written. Third, its writing system is based on the Latin alphabet and was created by Christian missionaries in the late nineteenth century. It includes two features that English does not have: the special letter ṭ ( latin small letter t with a dot below ), which represents a different sound from plain t , and vowels with a circumflex accent that show both tone and vowel length. Both are optional in everyday writing, so running text stays often under-specified relative to the prescriptive standard; we quantify this in Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 三个财产对我们的官司很重要。 首先,Mizo具有阳性,有广泛的颗粒和衍生的固定,所以一个根出现在许多表面;这一点在第4节的词汇和可能计数中显示出来. 第二,米佐是tonal,但这种语气只写了一部分. 第三,其书写系统以拉丁字母为基础,由十九世纪晚期的基督教传教士创建. 它包括了英语没有的两个特征:特殊字母QQ(在下面有一个点的拉丁小字母t),代表着与平原t不同的音色,以及带有既显示音调又显示元音长度的环形口音的元音. 两者在日常写作中都是可选的,因此运行的文本相对于指令性标准往往保持不够具体;我们在第4.3节中量化了这一点.

blocks.en: That missionary history similarly shapes the corpus. For decades, Bible translation was the main literate use of written Mizo, so religious texts dominate what is digitally available, while technical and administrative writing is scarce. Common-law concepts entered Mizo through English-medium administration and were never lexicalized as a coherent native system, so translating judicial prose depends on the borrowing behavior analyzed in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 传教士的传教史同样塑造了教体。 数十年来,圣经翻译是写作"米佐"(Mizo)的主要识字用法,因此宗教文本主导了数字化的可用,而技术和行政写作则稀缺. 英美法概念通过英美行政进入米佐,从未被从词汇化成连贯的本土系统,因此翻译司法传言取决于第4.2节所分析的借贷行为.

blocks.en: 2.2 Language technology for Mizo
blocks.zh: 2.2 米佐语言技术

blocks.en: Indian-language NLP has advanced mainly through corpora and models built for twenty-two scheduled languages [ 4 , 5 , 9 ] . Mizo is not a scheduled language, so most of these resources exclude it.
blocks.zh: 印第安语NLP主要通过corpora和为二十二种预定语言[4,5,9]建造的模型来推进. 米佐语不是排期语言,因此大部分这些资源都将其排除在外.

blocks.en: Mizo has entered modern multilingual NLP largely through massively multilingual projects. It appears as lus_Latn in the NLLB-200 models and the FLORES benchmark [ 6 , 10 ] , which makes NLLB-200 a natural starting point and motivates our choice of base model in Section 5 . Coverage does not guaranty quality, however: the Mizo training data in such systems is largely religious and crawled web text, and the evaluation sets are general-domain. Mizo-focused work has focused on building general-purpose parallel data and supervised and unsupervised NMT for the pair [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] ; to our knowledge, no resource in the legal-domain has been available.
blocks.zh: 米佐主要通过大规模多语种项目进入了现代多语种NLP. 它作为lus_Latn出现在NLLB-200模型和FLORES基准[6,10]中,这使得NLLB-200成为一个自然起点,并激励我们在第5节中选择基准模型. 然而,覆盖面并不保证质量:这类系统中的Mizo培训数据基本上是宗教的和爬行的网络文本,评价集是一般领域。 以水中为重点的工作侧重于建立通用并行数据,并对对对[11、12、13]的NMT进行监督和无监督;据我们所知,法律领域没有资源。

blocks.en: 2.3 Legal-domain translation and corpora
blocks.zh: 2.3 法律领域翻译和公司

blocks.en: Legal text remains a hard case for machine translation. Judgments use long, deeply nested sentences, fixed citation and case-title patterns, formal honorific language, and terms whose near-synonyms are not interchangeable: translating accused as convict , or petitioner as appellant changes the legal meaning. Here, correct terminology matters more than fluent language, and mistakes can harm the litigant.
blocks.zh: 法律文本仍然是机器翻译的难题。 判决使用冗长、深层的句子、固定的引用和案件标题模式、正式的荣誉语言以及其近似词不能互换的术语:将被告翻译为罪犯,或上诉人改变法律含义。 在这里,正确的术语比流利的语言更重要,错误会伤害诉讼当事人.

blocks.en: In Europe, large multilingual legal corpora produced by institutional translation– parliamentary proceedings, statutes, and case law [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] —have supported extensive work on legal MT and terminology. In India, legal NLP has grown to include judgment summarisation, rhetorical role labeling, as well as pretrained legal language models, supported by parallel datasets for several Indian languages [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] . These resources stop at the scheduled languages, so Mizo is absent. Our corpus extends this line of work to a non-scheduled language.
blocks.zh: 在欧洲,机构翻译(议会程序、法规和判例法[14、15、16])制作的大型多语种法律公司支持了关于法律MT和术语的广泛工作。 在印度,法律NLP已经发展到包括判决总结,修辞角色标签,以及预先训练的法律语言模型,辅以几种印度语言的并行数据集[17,18,19]. 这些资源停止使用预定语言,因此水佐缺席. 我们的教程将这一行扩展为非排期语言.

blocks.en: 3 Corpus Construction
blocks.zh: 3 公司建设

blocks.en: The corpus is made up of English-language judgments from the Gauhati High Court and the Supreme Court of India, including civil, criminal, and other types of cases. All documents come from official court records that are already publicly available, so we did not apply any extra anonymization beyond how the judgments are originally published.
blocks.zh: 案卷由高哈蒂高等法院和印度最高法院的英语判决组成,包括民事、刑事和其他类型的案件。 所有文件都来自已经公开的法院正式记录,因此我们除了最初公布判决的方式外,没有应用任何额外的匿名。

blocks.en: Document translation. The English judgments were translated into Mizo by a team of professional translators, all native Mizo speakers holding degrees in law, English, or Mizo. Translation was performed at the document level rather than sentence by sentence, so that translators could use the larger context to resolve ambiguity and keep terminology consistent within a judgment. Then each translated document was peer-reviewed by a second translator.
blocks.zh: 文件翻译。 英文判决书由专业翻译团队翻译为Mizo,所有本地的Mizo演讲者都拥有法学、英语或Mizo学位。 翻译是在文件一级进行,而不是按句子进行,以便笔译员能够利用更大的背景来解决含糊不清的问题,并使判决中的术语保持一致。 然后,每个翻译文件都由第二名翻译员进行同行评审。

blocks.en: Sentence alignment. After translation and review, we aligned the documents at sentence level. Both sides were first segmented into sentences, using spaCy [ 20 ] for English and NLTK [ 21 ] for Mizo. We then used an aligner that relies on multilingual sentence embeddings to generate possible sentence matches, and we ranked these candidates using cosine similarity. Since legal sentences are often long and complicated, we did not rely on automation alone: human annotators went through the suggested segments, fixed one-to-many and many-to-one mappings and made sure each matched pair had the same meaning.
blocks.zh: 句子对齐. 经过翻译和审查后,我们把文件与句子一致。 双方首先被分割成句子,英语使用spanCy [20],水深则使用NLTK [21]. 然后我们使用一个依赖多语种句子嵌入的对齐器来生成可能的句子匹配,我们用余弦的相似性来对这些候选人进行排名. 由于法律判决往往很长而且很复杂,我们并不只依靠自动化:人类的注释员通过建议的片段,固定了一对多和多对多的映射,确保每对匹配的对子具有相同的意义.

blocks.en: Validation. Two native Mizo speakers independently reviewed every pair to confirm that the two sentences were translations of each other. Inter-annotator agreement was high (Cohen’s κ = 0.90 \kappa=0.90 [ 22 ] ). Disagreements were referred to a third translator and resolved by a majority vote.
blocks.zh: 鉴定. 两位本地的米佐演讲者分别对每一对进行独立审查,确认两句是相互翻译. 说明人之间的协议很高(Cohen's $ 0.90\kappa=0.90 [22] )。 分歧被提交第三名翻译,并以多数票解决。

blocks.en: 4 Corpus Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 公司分析

blocks.en: This section describes the corpus in three dimensions: basic word statistics, how legal terms are borrowed and kept, and how consistently Mizo spelling is used. For all of this, we count only alphabetic tokens using Unicode-aware tokenization, and we exclude punctuation and standalone numbers.
blocks.zh: 本节从三个方面描述本体:基本字统计,如何借用和保存法律术语,如何连贯使用米佐拼写. 对于所有这些,我们只计算使用Unicode-aware符号化的字母符号,我们排除了标注和独立数字.

blocks.en: 4.1 Descriptive and lexical statistics
blocks.zh: 4.1 描述和词汇统计

blocks.en: Table 1: Descriptive statistics for the English–Mizo corpus.
blocks.zh: 表1:关于英语-Mizoacol的描述性统计。

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the corpus at the segment and token level. It contains 13 , 168 13,168 sentence pairs, 286 , 590 286,590 English, and 291 , 751 291,751 Mizo running tokens.

With almost the same number of tokens, the Mizo side has 16 % 16\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} more types than the English side, and 35.45 % 35.45\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of its types occur only once, compared to 24.00 % 24.00\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} in English. Two factors contribute. First, Mizo derivational and particle morphology produces a larger inventory of distinct surface forms. Second, the corpus has a long tail of Mizo personal and place names that appear in cause titles and are transferred unchanged to both sides. The lower character-per-word figure for Mizo indicates its predominantly CV and CVC syllable structure.
blocks.zh: Mizo方面几乎拥有相同数目的符号,与英语方面相比,Mizo方面拥有16%的16\text=,QQ mathrm=,35.45%的35.45\text=,QQ mathrm=,仅出现过一次,而英语方面拥有24.0%的24.00\text=,XQ mathrm=. 有两个因素。 首先,米佐衍生物和粒子形态产生一个更大的不同表面形态的清单. 第二,该人身保护令的尾巴很长的Mizo个人和地名出现在标题中,没有改变地转给双方。 米佐的较低字符/字数数字表示其以CV和CVC音节结构为主.

blocks.zh: 表2:按词汇等级分列的累计象征性覆盖率(%)。

blocks.zh: 图 1:标语频率的Zipf分布.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports cumulative token coverage by frequency rank. Beyond the first hundred types, the two languages are closely matched, with Mizo slightly lower in rank 5 , 000 5,000 , consistent with its heavier type tail. Figures 1 and 2 show that both sides follow the expected Zipfian frequency distribution and Heaps’ law vocabulary growth, with a higher Heaps exponent for Mizo ( β = 0.576 \beta=0.576 vs. 0.506 0.506 ). Mizo vocabulary keeps rising sharply with no clear plateau at 13,168 sentence pairs, indicating the legal corpus still lacks full lexical coverage and needs more data.

blocks.en: 4.2 Lexical borrowing and terminology retention
blocks.zh: 4.2 法律借贷和术语保留

blocks.en: Mizo doesn’t have its own traditional legal terms, so when Indian legal English is translated into Mizo, new words almost always have to be borrowed. This subsection measures how often that happens, and we see this borrowing as the most distinctive language feature in the whole set of the corpus.
blocks.zh: Mizo没有自己的传统法律术语, 所以当印度法律英语被翻译成Mizo时, 本小节衡量了这种情况的发生频率,我们把这种借阅视为整个本体中最独特的语言特征.

blocks.en: The aggregate borrowing is substantial (Table 3 ): 6 , 612 6,612 word types occur on both sides, 55.30 % 55.30\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of Mizo running tokens are strings that also appear in the English vocabulary, and the mean Jaccard token-level overlap per-pair is 0.4315 0.4315 .
blocks.zh: 总借款额相当大(表3):6,612,612个字型发生于两侧,55.30%=55.30\text=,Mizo运行符的QQ mathrm{\%}是英语词汇中也出现的字符串,平均Jacard符级每页重叠为0.43150.4315.

blocks.en: Table 3: Corpus-level lexical overlap (English–Mizo).
blocks.zh: 表3:公司级词汇重叠(英语-Mizo).

blocks.en: To separate selective borrowing from wholesale copying, we compute a retention rate for a hand-selected inventory of legal terms: the number of Mizo segments containing the term divided by the number of English segments containing it. Values near 100 % 100\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} indicate that the English form is carried over; low values indicate that the concept is lexicalized natively in Mizo. The results are in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 为了区分选择性借贷和批发复制,我们计算出一个手工选定的法律术语清单的留存率:包含该术语的米佐段数除以包含该术语的英语段数. 值接近100% 100\text\,QQ mathrm\\\表示英语形式被结转;值低表示概念在水佐本土化. 结果见表4。

blocks.en:
Table 4: Retention of English legal terms in the Mizo text. Ret. is the proportion of Mizo segments to English segments
that include the term.
blocks.zh:
表4: 米佐文本中英文法律术语的保留. Ret.是水津部分与英语部分的比例
包括这个词

blocks.en: The distribution is far from uniform, and the pattern is interpretable. Terms naming institutions, statutory instruments and fixed procedural labels — court , section , FIR , IPC , CrPC , affidavit , magistrate , bail —are retained at rates approaching 100 % 100\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} . Terms naming statuses, acts and inferential outcomes — accused ( 8.5 % 8.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ), conviction ( 5.0 % 5.0\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ), judgment ( 23.6 % 23.6\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ), evidence ( 37.1 % 37.1\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} )—are overwhelmingly rendered with native Mizo words.
blocks.zh: 分布远非统一,模式可解释. 命名机构、法定文书和固定的程序标签——法院、科、FIR、IPC、CRPC、宣誓书、地方法官、保释——被保留的比率接近100% 100\text §, }\ mathrm{\%}。 术语命名状况、行为和结果——被告(8.5% 8.5\text\, }\mathrm{\%}),定罪(5.0% 5.0\text\, }\mathrm{\%}),判决(23.6% 23.6\text\, }\mathrm{\%}), 证据(37.1% 37.1\text\, }\mathrm{\%})—— 绝大多数都是用原产地米佐语表达的。

blocks.en: We see this pattern as measuring how strongly a term is tied to a specific reference. When a term refers to something whose identity is fixed by law or institutional designation and mistranslating it would create referential ambiguity, the English form is preserved. Where a term describes a condition, a process, or a conclusion that can be expressed compositionally, Mizo lexicalizes it: thubuai for a case or dispute, dan for law or act, hriattirna for notice, thuneihna for jurisdiction or authority. The rate for learned ( 26.3 % 26.3\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) is a revealing minor case: the honorific register typical of Indian legal English is largely not carried in Mizo, so translation here involves register normalization and lexical substitution.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,这种模式衡量一个术语与具体提法的关联程度。 当一个术语是指其身份被法律或机构指定所确定,并被错误地译作它会造成偏好模糊时,英文形式被保留下来. 如果一个术语描述一个条件、一个过程或一个可以组成地表达的结论,Mizo将它写作:案件或争端用tubuai语,法律或行为用dan语,通知用hriattirna语,管辖权或权威用thuneihna语。 学习率(26.3 % 26.3\text →, }\ mathrm{\%} {\%} {\%} {\%} ))是一个显着的次要案例:典型的印度法律英语的荣誉登记册在米佐基本上没有携带,所以这里的翻译涉及注册正常化和词汇替代.

blocks.zh: 4.3 水深整形一致性

blocks.en:
Written Mizo adds two features to the Latin alphabet: the letter ṭ , which contrasts with t , and circumflex vowels that mark tone and length. We assess how consistently the corpus uses both.
Table 5 shows that both markers are rare. Circumflexes appear only in 2.70 % 2.70\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of the Mizo segments and 0.22 % 0.22\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of tokens, and 159 159 types occur both with and without them (Table 6 ). The letter ṭ is equally rare ( 282 282 tokens in 52 52 types), and the counts in Table 7 show that the t / ṭ contrast is largely not maintained.
blocks.zh:
书面的Mizo在拉丁字母中增加了两个特征:字母QQ,与t相对应,以及标有音调和长度的环形元音. 我们评估这本文书如何一致地使用两者。
表5显示,这两个标记都是罕见的. Circumflex只出现在2.70%的2.70\text\,Mizo区段的}\mathrm\,以及0.22%的0.22\text\, }\mathrm\的 tokens, 159 159 种同时出现和没有它们(表6). 字母QQ同样少见(共5252种,282,282个令牌),表7中的计数显示t/QQ对比基本没有维持.

blocks.en: We regard this as an open problem for Mizo NLP rather than a defect of the corpus. It is not yet clear whether models should be trained on text that keeps diacritics or on text where they are stripped, and the choice affects vocabulary size, segmentation cost, and the comparability of published results. We therefore release the corpus unnormalised, so that either convention can be applied downstream.
blocks.zh: 我们认为这对Mizo NLP来说是一个公开的问题,而不是人身保护的缺陷。 尚不清楚是应该对模型进行关于保留二极论的文本的培训,还是对被剥去的文本的培训,选择会影响词汇大小,分割成本,以及公布结果的可比性. 因此,我们解除了程序,使这两项公约都能在下游适用。

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: Table 8: Statistics of the training and test splits.
blocks.zh: 表8:培训统计和测试划分。

blocks.en: 5.1 Training data
blocks.zh: 5.1 培训数据

blocks.en: The training split contains 11 , 522 11,522 sentence pairs from the corpus described in Section 4 , with 245 , 838 245,838 English and 248 , 039 248,039 Mizo tokens (Table 8 ). It is formed after the set of benchmark tests is removed, and any sentence with more than 90 % 90\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} words overlaps with a test sentence. As in the corpus as a whole, the Mizo side has the larger vocabulary ( 13 , 205 13,205 vs. 11 , 929 11,929 types) and the higher TTR (0.053 vs. 0.049), consistent with the morphology and orthographic variation reported in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 培训分为11,522,11,522个句子,分别来自第4节所述程序,245,838,245,838个英语和248,039,248,039个。 米佐令牌(表8). 它在一组基准测试被移除后形成,任何句子超过90%的90\text~,Q}\mathrm{\%}的词与测试句重叠. 与整个生物体一样,米佐方有较大的词汇(13,205,13,205对11,929,11,929类)和较高的TTR(0.053对0.049),符合第4节中报告的形态和正体变异.

blocks.en: 5.2 Test data
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 测试数据

blocks.en: The benchmark test set contains 1 , 000 1,000 sentence pairs, with 21 , 990 21,990 English tokens and 23 , 150 23,150 Mizo tokens. Instead of choosing these examples at random, we deliberately focus on the kinds of sentences that make legal translation difficult: those with legal terms (230 pairs), abbreviations and acronyms (220), named entities (200), names of statutes and acts (150), and general legal writing (200); see Figure 3 . The relatively high type–token ratio (0.180 in English, 0.159 in Mizo) is mainly due to the smaller size of this split.
blocks.zh: 基准测试集包含1,000,1000句对,包含21,990,21,990个英文令牌和23,150,23,150个米佐令牌. 我们不是随意选择这些例子,而是刻意关注那些使法律翻译困难的句子:那些有法律术语(230对),缩略语和缩略语(220),被命名的实体(200),法规和行为的名称(150)和一般法律写作(200),见图3。 相对较高的类型-托肯比(英语:0.180,0.159 in Mizo)主要是由于这种分裂的大小较小.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows how much the test vocabulary overlaps with the training data: 82.5 % 82.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of English and 79.7 % 79.7\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of Mizo distinct word types in the test set also appear in training, and coverage at the token level is 96.6 % 96.6\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} and 96.5 % 96.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} , respectively. This means that the test set is challenging in terms of unique words—about one in five Mizo word types is new—yet still manageable when reading continuous text.
blocks.zh: 图4显示测试词汇与培训数据的重叠程度:英语的82.5% 82.5\text~,英语的QX mathrm~,英语的79.7% 79.7\text~,Mizo不同词型的QX mathrm~,也出现在培训中,标语的覆盖率分别为96.6% 96.6\text~,XXX mathrm~和96.5\text~,XQX mathrm~. 这意味着测试集在独特的单词方面是具有挑战性的——大约五分之一的水佐单词类型是新的——在读取连续文本时仍然无法管理.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Sentence types in the 1 , 000 1,000 -pair benchmark test set.
blocks.zh: 图3: 1 000 000-pair基准测试套中的句子类型。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Test set coverage by training set vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 图4:按培训词汇分类的测试范围。

blocks.en: 5.3 Model
blocks.zh: 5.3 型号

blocks.en: We use NLLB-200 [ 6 ] , a Meta AI model that covers 200 languages, and trained on substantial mined parallel datasets. It is the natural choice here because it is one of the few large-scale open-source translation models with explicit support from Mizo ( lus_Latn ), and serves as a strong baseline for low-resource translation. We evaluate both off the shelf and after fine-tuning and refer to the two systems as NLLB-200 1.3 1.3 B and NLLB-FT.
blocks.zh: 我们使用NLLB-200 [6],一个包含200种语言的Meta AI模型,并接受了关于大量地雷平行数据集的培训. 这是这里的自然选择,因为它是少数得到Mizo(lus_Latn)明确支持的大型开源翻译模型之一,并且是低资源翻译的有力基准. 我们既从架子上评价,又在微调后将两个系统称为NLLB-200 1.3 B和NLLB-FT.

blocks.en: 5.4 Fine-tuning and implementation
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 细化与实施.

blocks.en: Due to computational constraints, we use the 1.3 1.3 billion parameter variant of NLLB-200. Fine-tuning was performed with the Hugging Face transformer library [ 23 ] on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, using AdamW [ 24 ] with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} and a linear warm-up schedule. We train for 5 epochs with a batch size of 4 and leave all other hyperparameters at their library defaults. We translate in the English → \rightarrow Mizo direction throughout.
blocks.zh: 由于计算限制,我们使用13亿参数的变体NLLB-200. 在单NVIDIA A100 GPU上与Hugging Face变压器库进行了微调[23],使用AdamW[24],学习率为5×10−5\5Times 10×5]和线性热身表. 我们训练了5个世纪, 批量尺寸是4, 并留下所有其他超参数 在他们的图书馆默认。 我们用英文翻译,

blocks.en: 5.5 Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.5 计量

blocks.en: We report three complementary automatic metrics. • BLEU : case-sensitive sacreBLEU [ 25 ] , which fixes tokenisation and makes scores reproducible. Measures n-gram precision against the reference. • chrF++ : a character-level n-gram F-score [ 26 ] , well suited to a morphologically rich language such as Mizo and robust to tokenization differences. • TER : translation edit rate [ 27 ] , the minimum number of insertions, deletions, substitutions, and shifts needed to convert the output to reference, normalized by reference length. Lower is better; it approximates the post-editing effort.
blocks.zh: 我们报告三个辅助自动衡量标准。 • BLEU:对大小写有敏感认识的sacreBLEU[25],它修正了符号化,使分数可以复制。 对照参考标准衡量n-g精确度。 ^ chrF++:一种字符级n-gm F-score [26],非常适合米佐等形态丰富的语言,强力表示符号化差异. • TER :翻译编辑速率[27],插入、删除、替换的最小数量,以及将产出转换为参考所需的班次,按参考长度正常化。 下调更好,大致相当于编辑后的努力。

blocks.en: BLEU : case-sensitive sacreBLEU [ 25 ] , which fixes tokenisation and makes scores reproducible. Measures n-gram precision against the reference.
blocks.zh: BLEU : 大小写灵敏的sacreBLEU [25],它修正了标语化,使分数可以复制. 对照参考标准衡量n-g精确度。

blocks.en: chrF++ : a character-level n-gram F-score [ 26 ] , well suited to a morphologically rich language such as Mizo and robust to tokenization differences.
blocks.zh: chrF++:一种字符级n-gram F-score [26],非常适合米佐等形态丰富的语言,强势地表示差异.

blocks.en: TER : translation edit rate [ 27 ] , the minimum number of insertions, deletions, substitutions, and shifts needed to convert the output to reference, normalized by reference length. Lower is better; it approximates the post-editing effort.
blocks.zh: TER : 翻译编辑速率 [27] , 最小的插入,删除,替换次数,以及转换输出为引用所需的切换次数,按参考长度进行规范化. 下调更好,大致相当于编辑后的努力。

blocks.en: 6 Results
blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en: Table 9: Machine translation results on the 1 , 000 1,000 -pair benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表9:1 000 000-平方基准的机器翻译结果。

blocks.en: Table 10: NLLB-FT performance by test-set stratum.
blocks.zh: 表10:NLLB-FT按测试集层划分的性能.

blocks.en: Table 9 shows the overall results. When we fine-tune the model on legal texts from the target domain, all scores improve compared to the off-the-shelf model: BLEU goes from 20.31 20.31 to 27.47 27.47 ( + 7.16 +$7.16$ ), chrF++ from 42.56 42.56 to 50.39 50.39 ( + 7.83 +$7.83$ ), and TER drops from 77.81 77.81 to 65.68 65.68 ( − 12.13 -$12.13$ ). Since we see gains in both a surface-based metric and an edit-based metric, the improvements are due to better wording and sentence structure, not quirks of a single measure. The size of this improvement also makes it clear that general-domain multilingual pre-training by itself is not sufficient for Mizo legal translation.
blocks.zh: 表9显示了总体结果。 当我们从目标领域微调法律文本模型时,与现成模型相比,所有得分都有所改善:BLEU从20.31 20.31提高到27.47 27.47 (+ 7.16 + 7.16美元),chrF++从42.56 42.56下降到50.39 50.39 (+ 7.83 + 7.83 $), TER从77.81 77.81下降到65.68 65.68 ( - 12.13 - 12.13美元),由于我们看到基于地表的衡量和基于编辑的衡量方法都有增益,改进是由于措辞和句子结构的改善,而不是单项措施的曲折。 这一改进的规模也表明,一般域的多语种预训本身不足以进行米佐法律翻译.

blocks.en: 6.1 Analysis by stratum
blocks.zh: 6.1 按层次进行的分析

blocks.en: Overall scores hide patterns that are specific to legal texts, so we take a closer look at NLLB-FT using the stratified benchmark. Throughout this analysis, we compare the system’s output to the actual choices made by the human translator in the reference, instead of measuring it against some abstract idea of “correctness.” This approach helps us tell apart real mistakes from acceptable differences in how words or terms are borrowed.
blocks.zh: 总体分数隐藏着法律文本特有的规律,因此我们用分级基准更仔细地查看NLLB-FT. 在整个分析过程中,我们比较了系统的输出与人类翻译在参考文献中所作的实际选择,而不是以某些抽象的“正确性”概念来衡量。 这种办法有助于我们区分实际错误和在借词或条件方面可接受的差异。

blocks.en: Table 10 shows that BLEU scores vary by more than 14 14 points across different strata. Scores are highest when the source text includes content that can be copied directly into the translation—such as abbreviations ( 34.05 34.05 ) and statute names ( 32.18 32.18 )—and lowest for legal terms ( 19.71 19.71 ) and general prose ( 21.14 21.14 ), where the model has to pick an appropriate Mizo word instead of reusing the English one. In other words, the system is better at keeping English words than at replacing them with Mizo, and the next section shows that this single pattern explains most of the errors we see.
blocks.zh: 表10显示,不同阶层的低浓缩铀得分不同,超过14个14分。 当来源文本包括可直接复制到翻译中的内容时,得分最高——例如缩写(34.05 34.05)和法规名称(32.18 32.18)——法律术语(19.71 19.71)和一般口语(21.14 21.14)中得分最低,模型必须选一个适当的水佐词,而不是重用英语。 换句话说,系统保存英文单词比用米佐来代替更合适,下一节显示这种单一模式解释了我们看到的大部分错误.

blocks.en: 7 Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 7 错误分析

blocks.en: To see where NLLB-FT still fails, we inspect its output on the benchmark. The ordering in Table 10 is partly an artifact: strings that can be copied are copied, and copying is rewarded by surface metrics even when the resulting segment is not a translation. We therefore analyze the three critical strata separately, combining automatic extraction of term, entity, and acronym mentions with manual inspection of the flagged segments.
blocks.zh: 为了查看NLLB-FT仍然失败的地方,我们按基准检查它的输出. 表10中的顺序部分是一件文物:可以复制的字符串被复制,即使生成的片段不是翻译,复制也会被表面度量衡奖励. 因此,我们分别分析三个关键层面,将自动提取术语、实体和缩略语与人工检查标注部分结合起来。

blocks.en: 7.1 Legal terminology
blocks.zh: 7.1 法律术语

blocks.en: Section 4.2 showed that professional translators borrow selectively. The dominant failure of NLLB-FT is that it does not reproduce this pattern: it keeps English words where the translator uses a Mizo one. Across the 230 230 legal-term segments the model matches the reference choice in 150 150 ( 65.2 % 65.2\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ). Where the two differ, over-retention dominates: in 50 50 segments ( 21.7 % 21.7\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) the model copies the English term although the reference nativizes it, against only 19 19 segments ( 8.3 % 8.3\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) in the opposite direction (Table 11 ). The system therefore borrows roughly three times more often than the translator. A smaller but more serious class is meaning-shifting substitution ( 5 5 segments), where the model picks a Mizo word that changes the legal meaning, for example rendering accused as pawikhawihtu (‘troublemaker’).
blocks.zh: 第4.2节显示,专业笔译员有选择地借用。 NLLB-FT的主要失败在于它不复制这种图案:它保留了翻译使用米佐一的英语单词. 在230 230个法律学期中,该模型与150个参考选择相匹配(65.2% 65.2\text=, }\ mathrm{\%} )。 如果两者不同,则保留过多占主导地位:在50个区段(21.7% 21.7\text ~, }\ mathrm{\%} )中,模型复制了英文名词,尽管参考文献将其命名为notivization,而只有19个区段(8.3% 8.3\text →, }\ mathrm{\%} )则相反方向(表11). 因此,该系统的借用次数大约是笔译员的三倍。 一个较小但更严重的类别是意义转变的替代(5个5个部分),模型选择一个米佐词来改变法律意义,例如将被告当作 " 麻烦制造者 " 。

blocks.en: 7.2 Named entities
blocks.zh: 7.2 已命名的实体

blocks.en: The model usually handles named entities well. Out of the 842 842 entity mentions that the reference version copies word for word, the model reproduces 814 814 of them exactly ( 96.7 % 96.7\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ). This means that party names, place names, case numbers, and dates are mostly reliable (see Table 13 ).
blocks.zh: 该模型通常能很好地处理被命名的实体. 在842 842个实体中,提到参考版本逐字复制,该模型准确地复制了其中的814 814个(96.7%96.7\text ~,}\mathrm{\%}). 这意味着政党名称、地名、案件编号和日期大多是可靠的(见表13)。

blocks.en: The 15 15 corrupted forms are systematic rather than random. Plural institutional names are silently singularized ( District Councils → \rightarrow District Council ), which can change the body to which it being referred to; statute titles are rewritten in canonical form ( Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 → \rightarrow Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ), which is bibliographically correct but no longer the form used by the court; and low-frequency names drift orthographically ( Practices → \rightarrow Practises ).
blocks.zh: 15个腐败的形式是系统性的,而不是随机的。 多个机构名称无声无息地单一化(区议会),这些名称可以改变所指机构;法规名称以教条形式重写(《刑事诉讼法》,1973年),这在书目上是正确的,但已不再是法院使用的形式;低频名称按正字法漂移(惯例)

blocks.en: 7.3 Abbreviations and acronyms
blocks.zh: 7.3 简称和缩略语

blocks.en: The acronym strings are the most reliable part of the output (Table 13 ). Of the 208 208 acronym mentions that each reference includes, 203 203 ( 97.6 % 97.6\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) are copied exactly. Four are either dropped or loosely translated (for example, P.W.1 becomes Thuhretu-1 na ), and one has a minor change in the letter case ( Cr.PC → \rightarrow Cr.Pc ). Differences like ND&PS versus NDPS , or Cr.P.C. versus Cr.PC and CrPC , already appear in both the source and the reference, and the system preserves them as they are. This matches the broader corpus pattern, where legal abbreviations such as IPC ( 100.0 % 100.0\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) and FIR ( 100.0 % 100.0\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) are kept on the Mizo side near their original rates.
blocks.zh: 缩写字符串是产出中最可靠的部分(表13). 在208,208个缩略语中,每个引用都包括203,203个(97.6%97.6\text{\,}\mathrm{\%})被准确复制. 4个或被丢弃,或被松散翻译(例如,P.W.1成为Thuhretu-1 na ),1个字母大小写有小的改变(Cr.PC →\rightarrow Cr.Pc ). 如ND&PS对NDPS的区别,或Cr.P.C对Cr.PC和CrPC的区别,已经出现在来源和参考文献中,系统保留了它们原样. 这与广义的物状模式相匹配,例如IPC(100.0%-100.0\text{\,}\mathrm{\%})和FIR(100.0%-100.0\text{\,}\mathrm{\%})等法律缩写都保存在水泽一侧,接近其原始利率.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduce the first English–Mizo parallel corpus in the legal domain: 13 , 168 13,168 sentence pairs taken from Indian court judgments. Professional native Mizo translators worked at the document level, and the sentence pairs were then manually aligned and independently validated. Two findings stand out. First, when Indian legal English is translated into Mizo, there is a clear pattern of borrowing: the names of institutions and laws are kept almost unchanged, while descriptions of events, processes, and outcomes are translated using native Mizo words. We interpret this pattern as a way to keep legal references very stable. Second, real-world Mizo writing does not use diacritics consistently. As a result, deciding whether and how to normalize diacritics is still an open preprocessing option, not a settled one.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍法律领域的第一套英文-Mizo平行法:13,168,13,168句取自印度法院的判决。 专业本土的米佐翻译在文件一级工作,然后将句子对齐并独立验证. 有两个发现是突出的。 第一,当印度法律英语被翻译成米佐语时,有明显的借词模式:机构和法律的名称几乎保持不变,而事件,过程和结果的描述则使用当地米佐语翻译. 我们把这种模式解释为保持法律参考资料非常稳定的一种方式。 第二,现实世界的水佐写作并不连贯地使用二甲论. 因此,决定是否以及如何使二极论正常化仍然是开放的预处理选项,而不是一个解决的选项.

blocks.en: Our baseline results show that fine-tuning on in-domain data really helps: the NLLB-200 1.3 1.3 B model improves by + 7.16 +$7.16$ BLEU on a carefully sampled legal test set. However, our error analysis shows that the remaining problems are exactly in the areas where English borrowing is most likely. The fine-tuned system copies English words in the translation about three times more often than a human translator does.
blocks.zh: 我们的基线结果显示,对域内数据进行微调确实有助于: NLLB-200 1.3 B型在经过仔细取样的法律测试集上改进了+7.16+7.16 BLEU. 然而,我们的误差分析表明,剩下的问题恰恰发生在最有可能借到英语的地区。 微调的系统在翻译中复制英语单词的频率大约是人类翻译的三倍.

blocks.en: This suggests two directions. On the modeling side, terminology-aware objectives or constrained decoding informed by a retention lexicon could help a system learn when to borrow rather than borrowing by default. On the evaluation side, terminology-sensitive metrics are needed, since BLEU and chrF++ credit copying.
blocks.zh: 这说明有两个方向。 在建模方面,术语意识目标或以保留词典为参考的限制性解码可有助于系统学会何时借贷而不是默认借贷。 在评价方面,由于BLEU和chrF++信用复制,需要采用对术语敏感的衡量标准。
